Name: Alchemist's Kit
Description: Complete starter kit for alchemists including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, ink, inkpen, iron pot, mess kit, soap, torches, trail rations, waterskin, and most importantly - alchemist's lab for crafting alchemical items. Essential for bomb-throwing and mutagen-brewing alchemists.

Name: Arcane Adept Package
Description: Premium package for arcane spellcasters with focus on magical prowess. Includes quality robes, spellbook with extra pages, writing supplies, spell component pouch, scrolls, and various magical tools. Designed for wizards and similar casters who want to start with superior gear.

Name: Arcanist's Kit
Description: Specialized kit for arcanists who blend wizardry and sorcery. Contains backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, ink, inkpen, iron pot, mess kit, soap, torches, trail rations, waterskin, and spellbook. Perfect for the spontaneous arcane caster.

Name: Arctic Kit
Description: Survival gear for frigid climates including cold-weather outfit, snowshoes, crampons for icy terrain, furred bedroll, and supplies to prevent frostbite. Essential for arctic expeditions and mountain climbing in winter.

Name: Barbarian's Kit
Description: Rugged survival kit for barbarians. Includes backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, iron pot, rope, soap, torches, trail rations, and waterskin. Simple, durable gear for warriors who rage in battle.

Name: Bard's Kit
Description: Performance and adventuring gear for bards including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, common musical instrument, costume, flint and steel, ink, inkpen, iron pot, journal, mess kit, mirror, rope, soap, torches, trail rations, and waterskin. Everything for the traveling performer.

Name: Bloodrager's Kit
Description: Combat-ready kit for bloodragers who channel arcane power through their rage. Contains backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, iron pot, rope, soap, torches, trail rations, and waterskin. Built for magical berserkers.

Name: Bounty Hunter's Kit (common)
Description: Professional equipment for tracking and capturing bounties including manacles, rope, gag, blindfold, and tools for restraining targets. Basic version for everyday bounty work.

Name: Bounty Hunter's Kit (superior)
Description: Premium bounty hunting equipment with masterwork manacles, superior quality restraints, tracking tools, and specialized gear for capturing dangerous targets alive. For professional man-hunters.

Name: Brawler's Kit
Description: Gear for brawlers who fight with flexibility and martial prowess. Includes backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, iron pot, rope, soap, torches, trail rations, and waterskin. For unarmed combat specialists.

Name: Breaker's Kit
Description: Specialized tools for breaking through barriers including crowbars, hammers, chisels, wedges, and other implements for smashing down doors, walls, and fortifications. Essential for siege work and breaching operations.

Name: Campsite Kit
Description: Complete camp setup for a group including tent, bedrolls, cooking equipment, campfire supplies, and basic comforts. Heavy but provides everything needed for wilderness camping.

Name: Cat Burglar's Kit
Description: Tools of the trade for thieves specializing in climbing and second-story work. Includes climbing gear, dark clothing, rope, and tools for quiet entry. NOT legal for organized play.

Name: Cavalier's Kit
Description: Mounted warrior's equipment including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, iron pot, rope, soap, torches, trail rations, waterskin, and feed for mount. Very heavy due to horse care supplies.

Name: Chirurgeon's Kit
Description: Advanced medical equipment for surgeons including scalpels, sutures, bandages, antiseptics, and specialized surgical tools. Provides bonuses to Heal checks for treating wounds and performing surgery.

Name: Chronicler's Kit
Description: Complete writing supplies for historians and scribes including multiple bottles of ink, numerous pens, blank journals, parchment, bookbinding supplies, and portable writing desk. Perfect for recording adventures.

Name: Cleric's Kit
Description: Divine caster's essentials including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, candles, cheap holy text, flint and steel, iron pot, mess kit, rope, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, wooden holy symbol, and waterskin.

Name: Cooking Kit
Description: Pots, pans, utensils, and supplies for preparing meals in the wilderness or camp. Includes seasonings and basic cooking tools. Much better than eating cold rations!

Name: Courtesan's Kit
Description: Beauty supplies and tools of seduction including cosmetics, perfume, jewelry, fine clothing accessories, and items for enhancing appearance and charm. For professional companions and those who use guile.

Name: Daring Bravo Package
Description: Premium package for swashbuckling warriors emphasizing finesse, style, and panache. Includes quality weapons, fashionable clothing, dueling equipment, and all the gear needed for a dashing swordsman.

Name: Desert Kit
Description: Survival gear for arid climates including hot-weather outfit, extra waterskins, sunblock, sand goggles, light cloth for sun protection, and supplies to prevent dehydration and sun exposure.

Name: Diver's Kit
Description: Equipment for underwater exploration including weighted belt, waterproof containers, breathing tube, underwater light sources, and specialized gear for subaquatic adventures.

Name: Dragonslayer's Kit
Description: Specialized equipment for hunting dragons including fireproof gear, acid-resistant items, tools for harvesting dragon parts, and weapons effective against scaled beasts. Very expensive but essential for dragon hunters.

Name: Druid's Kit
Description: Nature-focused gear including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, holly and mistletoe, iron pot, mess kit, rope, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, waterskin, and wooden holy symbol.

Name: Dungeoneering Kit (common)
Description: Basic underground exploration gear including rope, torches, chalk for marking paths, pitons, crowbar, and basic tools for navigating dungeons. Affordable option for novice delvers.

Name: Dungeoneering Kit (deluxe)
Description: Premium dungeon exploration equipment with superior quality ropes, better light sources, mapping supplies, tools for detecting traps, and specialized gear. Lighter and more effective than common version.

Name: Elemental Explorer's Kit
Description: Extremely expensive magical kit for traveling the elemental planes. Includes protections against extreme temperatures, breathing apparatus for airless environments, and specialized tools for planar travel. ALWAYS costs 2,700 gp regardless of discounts. NOT PFS legal.

Name: Emergency Interrogation Kit
Description: High-end interrogation equipment including truth serums, torture implements, intimidation tools, and alchemical substances for extracting information quickly. Very expensive, very light, very effective.

Name: Entertainer's Kit
Description: Basic performance supplies including simple costume pieces, face paint, juggling balls or similar props. Cheapest kit available, perfect for street performers.

Name: Exorcism Kit
Description: Sacred items for banishing spirits and possessing entities including holy water, blessed salts, religious texts, exorcism rituals, candles, incense, and protective wards. Essential for dealing with hauntings.

Name: Fiendslayer's Kit
Description: Specialized gear for hunting devils, demons, and other evil outsiders. Includes holy water, cold iron weapons, protective circles, and tools for banishing fiends. Third most expensive kit.

Name: Fighter's Kit
Description: Warrior's essentials including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, iron pot, rope, soap, torches, trail rations, and waterskin. No-frills adventuring gear for martial combatants.

Name: Fire Giant Hunter's Kit
Description: Specialized equipment for hunting fire giants including cold-based weapons, fire resistance potions, heat-proof gear, and tools sized for fighting huge opponents.

Name: Fire Pump
Description: Large manual pump for fighting fires. Requires multiple operators to use effectively. Essential for towns and keeps. Extremely heavy - 500 pounds!

Name: Fishing Kit
Description: Fishing pole, hooks, line, lures, and net for catching fish. Provides food while traveling near water. Very cheap utility kit.

Name: Forest Kit
Description: Woodland survival gear including camouflage clothing, tree climbing equipment, insect repellent, and supplies for navigating dense forests.

Name: Fraudulent Medium's Kit
Description: Props and tricks for faking séances and spirit communication including hidden compartments, false ectoplasm, voice-throwing devices, and stage magic equipment for charlatan spiritualists.

Name: Frost Giant Hunter's Kit
Description: Specialized equipment for hunting frost giants including fire-based weapons, cold resistance potions, ice-proof gear, and tools for fighting in frozen environments.

Name: Gambler's Kit (cheating)
Description: Professional cheating equipment including loaded dice, marked cards, card-holding devices, and other tools for rigging games of chance. Expensive but very profitable if not caught!

Name: Gambler's Kit (common)
Description: Standard gambling supplies including dice, cards, gaming tokens, and table for setting up games. For honest gamblers or those who cheat the old-fashioned way.

Name: Gear Maintenance Kit
Description: Tools for maintaining equipment including oil for weapons and armor, leather treatment, cloth for cleaning, needle and thread for repairs, and basic maintenance supplies.

Name: Ghost Hunter's Kit
Description: Equipment for tracking and combating incorporeal undead including ghost touch items, salt lines, holy water, detection devices, and tools for dealing with spirits.

Name: Giant Lair Infiltrator's Kit
Description: Specialized gear for sneaking into giant lairs including climbing equipment sized for huge architecture, giant-sized decoys, and tools for avoiding detection by enormous humanoids.

Name: Gravedigger's Kit
Description: Professional burial equipment including shovels, pickaxes, consecration materials, coffin-building tools, and supplies for properly interring the dead.

Name: Guard's Kit
Description: Standard guard equipment including signal horn, manacles, rope, lantern, and supplies for watch duty and patrol work. Perfect for city guards and sentries.

Name: Gunslinger's Kit
Description: Firearms specialist's gear including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, gunsmith's kit for maintenance, iron pot, rope, soap, torches, trail rations, and waterskin. Essential for those who sling lead.

Name: Gunsmith's Kit
Description: Tools for crafting and repairing firearms including files, hammers, cleaning rods, and specialized equipment for gunsmithing. Necessary for maintaining firearms.

Name: Holy Warrior Package
Description: Premium package for paladins and holy champions including quality armor, blessed weapons, religious texts, healing supplies, and everything needed for righteous crusaders. Very heavy but comprehensive.

Name: Hunter's Kit
Description: Wilderness warrior's gear for hunters who bond with animal companions. Includes backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, iron pot, rope, soap, torches, trail rations, waterskin, and animal feed.

Name: Infiltration Kit
Description: Professional spy equipment including disguise supplies, forgery tools, lockpicks, silent shoes, dark clothing, and gear for covert operations. For serious infiltrators.

Name: Inquisitor's Kit
Description: Heretic hunter's gear including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, candles, flint and steel, holy text, iron pot, mess kit, rope, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, wooden holy symbol, and waterskin.

Name: Interrogation Tools
Description: Basic interrogation implements including intimidation tools, restraints, and simple equipment for extracting information. Much cheaper than the emergency version.

Name: Investigator's Kit
Description: Detective's equipment including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, ink, inkpen, iron pot, magnifying glass, measuring cord, mess kit, soap, torches, trail rations, and waterskin. Everything for solving mysteries.

Name: Invisible Enemies Kit
Description: Specialized gear for detecting and fighting invisible foes including see invisibility potions, glitterdust, flour for revealing footprints, and tools for tracking unseen opponents. NOT PFS legal.

Name: Kineticist's Kit
Description: Elemental channeler's basic gear including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, iron pot, rope, soap, torches, trail rations, and waterskin. One of the cheapest class kits.

Name: Knight's Kit
Description: Noble warrior's equipment including quality armor, heraldic surcoat, lance, banner, and all the supplies needed for a proper knight. Expensive and carries significant social weight.

Name: Light Kit
Description: Comprehensive lighting equipment including sunrods, everburning torches, lanterns, oil, and various light sources for all situations. Never be caught in the dark!

Name: Lore Seeker Package
Description: Premium package for knowledge-focused adventurers including extensive books, research materials, translation guides, and tools for uncovering ancient secrets.

Name: Magus's Kit
Description: Spellblade's equipment including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, ink, inkpen, iron pot, mess kit, rope, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, waterskin, and spellbook.

Name: Medium's Kit
Description: Spiritual channeler's gear including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, candles, flint and steel, harrow deck, incense, iron pot, mess kit, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, and waterskin.

Name: Melee Contingency Kit
Description: Backup melee weapons and gear for spellcasters who need emergency close-combat options. Includes various small weapons, armor pieces, and defensive equipment for when spells fail.

Name: Mesmerist's Kit
Description: Hypnotist's equipment including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, ink, inkpen, iron pot, mess kit, rope, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, and waterskin.

Name: Mess Kit
Description: Simple tin plate, cup, fork, and knife for eating. The absolute cheapest kit available at only 2 silver pieces!

Name: Mobile Hospital
Description: Complete portable medical facility including surgery table, medical supplies, beds, bandages, medicines, and everything needed to treat wounded soldiers in the field. Extremely heavy but saves lives.

Name: Monk's Kit
Description: Ascetic warrior's simple gear including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, iron pot, rope, soap, torches, trail rations, and waterskin. Minimal possessions for those who need little.

Name: Monster Hunter's Kit (aberration)
Description: Specialized gear for hunting aberrations like beholders and mind flayers. Includes mental protection, anti-psionics items, and tools effective against creatures with alien anatomies.

Name: Monster Hunter's Kit (fey)
Description: Equipment for tracking and combating fey creatures. Includes cold iron items, salt, tools for breaking enchantments, and defenses against fey magic and tricks.

Name: Monster Hunter's Kit (ooze)
Description: Specialized gear for fighting oozes and slimes. Includes acid-resistant containers, pole-mounted weapons for keeping distance, and substances that harm amorphous creatures.

Name: Monster Hunter's Kit (regular)
Description: General-purpose monster hunting equipment effective against common threats. Includes silver weapons, basic alchemical items, and versatile hunting tools.

Name: Musk Kit
Description: Various scents for masking your own smell or laying false trails. Includes animal musks, perfumes, and odor-covering substances for evading tracking by scent.

Name: Mystic Guide Package
Description: Premium package for divine casters and spiritual leaders. Includes quality religious items, healing supplies, blessed equipment, and everything needed for clerics and oracles who lead others.

Name: Occultist's Kit
Description: Psychic magic user's gear including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, candles, flint and steel, inkpen, iron pot, mess kit, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, waterskin, and various implements.

Name: Oracle's Kit
Description: Divinely-touched caster's essentials including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, iron pot, rope, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, waterskin, and wooden holy symbol.

Name: Out-of-Towner's Kit
Description: Compact city survival kit for visitors including maps, local currency, disguise elements, and information about urban customs. Extremely light - only 1 pound!

Name: Paladin's Kit
Description: Holy warrior's gear including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, cheap holy text, flint and steel, iron pot, rope, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, wooden holy symbol, and waterskin.

Name: Pathfinder's Kit
Description: Standard adventuring kit for Pathfinder Society agents including rope, pitons, wayfinder polish, journal for documenting discoveries, and essential exploration tools.

Name: Phrenologist's Kit
Description: Skull-reading equipment including calipers, charts, measuring tools, and phrenological models. For those who claim to divine personality from skull shape.

Name: Planar Traveler's Kit
Description: Compact gear for surviving the planes including environmental protections, plane-shift materials, and tools for navigating extraplanar environments. Very light!

Name: Portable Prison
Description: Portable cell with bars, locks, and restraints for transporting prisoners. Very heavy but secure. Essential for bounty hunters and law enforcement.

Name: Psychic's Kit
Description: Mental magic user's essentials including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, ink, inkpen, iron pot, mess kit, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, and waterskin.

Name: Pyramid Buster's Kit
Description: Tomb raiding equipment specialized for ancient pyramids. Includes tools for navigating trapped corridors, hieroglyphic translation guides, mummy-fighting supplies, and curse protection.

Name: Pyrography Kit
Description: Wood-burning tools including heated stylus, patterns, and materials for creating decorative burned designs on wood. One of the cheapest profession kits.

Name: Questing Knight Package
Description: Complete package for knights-errant on holy quests. Includes armor, weapons, mount equipment, heraldry, and all supplies for noble adventuring. Heaviest of the 1,000 gp packages!

Name: Ranger's Kit
Description: Wilderness warrior's equipment including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, iron pot, rope, soap, torches, trail rations, and waterskin. Built for trackers and hunters.

Name: Riding Kit (common)
Description: Standard equipment for mounted travel including saddle, bit and bridle, saddlebags, riding boots, and horse care supplies.

Name: Riding Kit (exotic mount)
Description: Specialized gear for exotic mounts like griffons or giant lizards. Includes custom saddles and equipment adapted for unusual anatomy.

Name: Rogue's Kit
Description: Professional thief's gear including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, caltrops, chalk, flint and steel, grappling hook, iron pot, pitons, rope, sack, soap, thieves' tools, torches, trail rations, and waterskin.

Name: Scrivener's Kit
Description: Basic writing supplies for professional scribes including ink, pen, parchment, and blotting sand. Very light and affordable.

Name: Seance Kit
Description: Equipment for contacting spirits including candles, incense, spirit board, ectoplasmic detection powder, and ritual components. For actual séances, not frauds.

Name: Shadowy Stalker Package
Description: Premium package for assassins and shadow-dancers. Includes dark clothing, poisoner's tools, silent weapons, and everything needed for deadly stealth operations.

Name: Shaman's Kit
Description: Spirit-caller's gear including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, holly and mistletoe, iron pot, rope, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, waterskin, and wooden holy symbol.

Name: Shaving Kit
Description: Razor, mirror, soap, and towel for grooming. Extremely light - only half a pound!

Name: Skald's Kit
Description: Battle-poet's equipment including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, common musical instrument, flint and steel, ink, inkpen, iron pot, journal, mess kit, rope, soap, torches, trail rations, and waterskin.

Name: Skeleton Slayer's Kit
Description: Specialized gear for destroying skeletal undead including bludgeoning weapons, holy water, and tools for smashing bones to prevent reanimation.

Name: Slayer's Kit
Description: Assassin's equipment including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, grappling hook, ink, inkpen, iron pot, rope, soap, thieves' tools, torches, trail rations, and waterskin.

Name: Sorcerer's Kit
Description: Spontaneous caster's basic gear including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, iron pot, rope, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, and waterskin. Cheapest caster kit.

Name: Spelunking Kit
Description: Professional cave exploration equipment including superior ropes, advanced light sources, climbing gear, cave mapping supplies, and safety equipment for deep underground work.

Name: Spiritualist's Kit
Description: Phantom-bonding caster's gear including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, candles, flint and steel, inkpen, iron pot, mess kit, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, and waterskin.

Name: Spycatcher's Kit
Description: Counter-intelligence equipment including spy detection tools, code-breaking supplies, interrogation aids, and devices for uncovering hidden operatives.

Name: Spy's Kit
Description: Professional espionage equipment including disguise supplies, lockpicks, secret message materials, and covert communication tools.

Name: Summoner's Kit
Description: Eidolon-caller's basic gear including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, iron pot, rope, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, and waterskin.

Name: Survival Kit (common)
Description: Basic wilderness survival supplies including flint and steel, fishhook, cord, and emergency food. Very affordable.

Name: Survival Kit (masterwork)
Description: Premium survival equipment with superior quality tools, better food preservation, advanced fire-starting, and all the best wilderness gear.

Name: Swashbuckler's Kit
Description: Dashing duelist's equipment including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, grappling hook, iron pot, rope, soap, torches, trail rations, and waterskin.

Name: Taxidermy Tools
Description: Specialized equipment for preserving and mounting animal specimens including scalpels, preservatives, stuffing materials, and tools for creating lifelike displays.

Name: Tracker's Kit
Description: Professional tracking equipment including scent markers, magnifying lenses, casting materials for footprints, tracking dogs' supplies, and advanced tools for following quarry.

Name: Trapper's Kit
Description: Complete trap-setting equipment including various traps, chains, bait, lures, and tools for capturing animals alive. Very heavy with all the metal traps.

Name: Traveling Garden
Description: Portable greenhouse with soil, seeds, watering system, and plant care tools. Allows growing fresh food while traveling. Extremely heavy!

Name: Trickster's Kit
Description: Advanced infiltrator's gear combining thief's tools, alchemical items, magical trinkets, and specialized equipment for overcoming defenses and pulling off elaborate heists.

Name: Troll Slayer's Kit
Description: Specialized gear for hunting trolls including fire and acid supplies for preventing regeneration, pole-mounted weapons, and protection against their claws.

Name: Tropical Kit
Description: Jungle survival gear including insect repellent, lightweight breathable clothing, hammock for sleeping above ground, and tools for navigating dense vegetation. Surprisingly light!

Name: Undead Slayer's Kit
Description: Comprehensive anti-undead equipment including holy water, wooden stakes, garlic, mirrors, blessed items, and tools for destroying various types of undead.

Name: Undead Survivor's Kit
Description: Emergency gear for escaping undead apocalypse scenarios. Compact but expensive with holy symbols, undead repellents, and tools for avoiding detection by the unliving. Only 3 pounds!

Name: Undeath Aid Kit
Description: Medical supplies for treating intelligent undead including blood substitutes, preservatives for rotting flesh, and alchemical treatments for undead conditions. Lightest substantial kit - half a pound!

Name: Underground Survival Kit
Description: Complete Darklands survival package including darkvision items, cave navigation tools, climbing gear, anti-radiation protection, and supplies for surviving deep underground for extended periods.

Name: Vampire Slayer's Kit
Description: Specialized vampire hunting equipment including wooden stakes, holy water, garlic, mirrors, silvered weapons, and tools for detecting and destroying vampires. Classic monster hunter gear!

Name: Warpriest's Kit
Description: Battle-cleric's equipment including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, candles, cheap holy text, flint and steel, iron pot, rope, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, wooden holy symbol, and waterskin.

Name: Watchman's Kit
Description: Basic town guard equipment including lantern, whistle, manacles, and supplies for patrol duty. Very affordable for city watch.

Name: Wilderness Wanderer Package
Description: Premium package for rangers and druids emphasizing wilderness survival and nature magic. Includes quality outdoor gear, animal companion supplies, and everything for long-term wilderness adventuring. NOT PFS legal.

Name: Witch's Kit
Description: Hex-using caster's gear including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, familiar food, flint and steel, ink, inkpen, iron pot, rope, soap, spell component pouch, torches, trail rations, and waterskin.

Name: Wizard's Kit
Description: Arcane scholar's essentials including backpack, bedroll, belt pouch, flint and steel, ink, inkpen, iron pot, rope, soap, spell component pouch, spellbook, torches, trail rations, and waterskin.

Name: Zombie Slayer's Kit
Description: Zombie-fighting equipment including head-removal tools, body-burning supplies, blessed weapons, and gear for permanently destroying shambling undead before they rise again.
